channel.title: U.S. Census Bureau Economic Briefing Room
channel.description: Key National Economic Indicators Published by the U.S. Census Bureau

item.title: Housing Vacancies and Homeownership
item.description:
The homeownership rate of 65.5 percent was not statistically different from the rate in the third quarter 2025. The homeownership rates in the Northeast, Midwest, South, and West were not statistically different from third quarter 2025 rates.


3rd Qtr 2026: +0.2* Percentage Points
3rd Qtr 2025: -0.3* Percentage Points

item.title: Rental Vacancy Rate
item.description:
The rental vacancy rate of 7.6 percent was higher than the rate in the third quarter 2025. Compared to the third quarter 2025, the rental vacancy rates were higher in the Northeast and West, and they were not statistically different in the Midwest and South.


3rd Qtr 2026: +0.5 Percentage Points
3rd Qtr 2025: +0.2* Percentage Points

item.title: Advance U.S. International Trade in Goods
item.description:
The advance international trade deficit in goods increased to $134.9 billion in September from $132.1 billion in August as imports increased more than exports.


September 2026: 2.1° % Change
August 2026: 11.1° % Change

item.title: Advance Wholesale Inventories
item.description:
September end-of-month inventories were $1,011.5 billion, up 0.6 percent (+/- 0.2 percent) from last month.


September 2026: +0.6 % Change in Inventories
August 2026 (r): +0.5 % Change in Inventories

item.title: Advance Retail Inventories
item.description:
September 2026 end-of-month inventories were $885.3 billion, up 0.3 percent (+/-0.2 percent) from last month.


September 2026: +0.3 % Change in Inventories
August 2026 (r): +0.3 % Change in Inventories

item.title: New Home Sales
item.description:
Sales of new single-family houses in September 2026 were at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 676,000. This is 0.6 percent (+/- 13.8%)* below the revised August 2026 estimate of 680,000.


September 2026: -0.6* % Change
August 2026 (r): +5.1* % Change

item.title: Advance Monthly Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories, and Orders
item.description:
New orders for manufactured durable goods in September, up six of the last seven months, increased $6.3 billion or 1.8 percent to $345.4 billion.


September 2026: +1.8° % Change
August 2026 (r): +0.1° % Change

item.title: New Residential Construction
item.description:
Privately-owned housing starts in September 2026 were at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1,221,000. This is 5.2 percent (+/- 11.8%)* below the revised August 2026 estimate of 1,288,000.


September 2026: -5.2* % Change
August 2026 (r): -5.9* % Change

item.title: Manufacturing and Trade Inventories and Sales
item.description:
U.S. total business end-of-month inventories for August 2026 were $2,818.8 billion, up 0.4 percent (+/- 0.1 percent) from last month. U.S. total business sales were $2,123.5 billion, up 1.1 percent (+/- 0.1 percent) from last month.


August 2026: +0.4 % Change in Inventories
July 2026 (r): +0.9 % Change in Inventories

item.title: Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services
item.description:
U.S. retail and food services sales for September 2026 were $745.0 billion, up 0.8 percent (+/-0.4 percent) from the previous month.


September 2026: +0.8 % Change
August 2026 (r): +1.3 % Change

item.title: Business Formation Statistics
item.description:
Total U.S. Business Applications were 534,947 in September 2026, up 0.5% from August 2026.


September 2026: +0.5° % Change
August 2026 (r): -7.7° % Change

item.title: Monthly Wholesale Trade: Sales and Inventories
item.description:
August 2026 sales of merchant wholesalers were $817.5 billion, up 1.8 percent (+/- 0.2 percent) from last month. End-of-month inventories were $964.2 billion, up 0.5 percent (+/- 0.2 percent) from last month.


August 2026: +0.5 % Change in Inventories
July 2026 (r): +1.4 % Change in Inventories

item.title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services
item.description:
The nation's international trade deficit in goods and services increased to $105.6 billion in August from $92.8 billion in July (revised), as imports increased more than exports.


August 2026: 13.7° % Change
July 2026 (r): 30.4° % Change

item.title: Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories, and Orders
item.description:
New orders for manufactured goods in August, up two consecutive months, increased $0.7 billion or 0.1 percent to $663.5 billion.


August 2026: +0.1° % Change
July 2026 (r): +0.8° % Change

item.title: Construction Spending
item.description:
Total construction spending for August 2026 ($2,203.1 billion) was 0.9 percent (+/- 1.0 percent)* above the revised July 2026 ($2,184.5 billion) estimate.


August 2026: 0.9* % Change
July 2026 (r): -0.1* % Change

item.title: Quarterly Services Survey
item.description:
U.S. selected services total revenue for the second quarter of 2026, adjusted for seasonal variation but not for price changes, was $6,418.7 billion, an increase of 3.0 percent (+/- 0.4 percent) from the first quarter of 2026 and up 7.6 percent (+/- 0.6 percent) from the second quarter of 2025. The first quarter of 2026 to second quarter of 2026 percentage change was revised from the advance estimate of 3.1 percent (+/- 0.4 percent).


2nd Qtr 2026: +3.0 % Change
1st Qtr 2026 (r): +1.1 % Change

item.title: Quarterly Financial Report - Retail
item.description:
Not seasonally adjusted after-tax profits for retail corporations with assets of $50 million and over were $112.3 billion for the second quarter 2026 (the 3 months ending July 31, 2026), up $47.2 (+/- 0.5) billion from first quarter 2026 (the 3 months ending April 30, 2026).


2nd Qtr 2026: +47.2 Billions of Dollars
1st Qtr 2026 (r): +1.7 Billions of Dollars

item.title: Quarterly Financial Report
item.description:
Manufacturing corporations' not seasonally adjusted after-tax profits were $370.1 billion for the second quarter of 2026, up $82.8 (+/- 1.2) billion from first quarter of 2026.


2nd Qtr 2026: +82.8 Billions of Dollars
1st Qtr 2026 (r): +50.6 Billions of Dollars
